title: Overpriced Item
text:
Overpriced Item. My first thought when I opened the box was that this is very overpriced. The only metal parts are the base and the center post. The things the boots hang on are plastic. Considering you can only hang 5 pairs of boots, it is really a lot of sugar for a cent. I got this to clean up the garage of all the farm boots, which are heavy and always pretty nasty. You have to grab the boots by the sole or ankle to put them on the hooks. Great. I really want to play in the chicken crap to get my boots on the rack.
Second thing you need to know is that the center post is in sections. One of those sections is longer than the other 4. Unfortunately the way the box is packed, that's the last one you came to. So my rack is too short on the bottom and the bottom pair of boots drags on the ground. I know, I could take it apart, but the thing is difficult to get sturdy and I'm not up for that.
Stability is OK, but the center post wobbles.
All in all I would never buy this. Too much money for not a very large benefit.
